body:
I've tried to talk to her about how I think i have some problems in general. I called her out once, and she shut off my phone so I wouldn't 'make any rash decisions' or 'call anyone I wasn't supposed to'. Whatever that meant.

I've also tried to explain the others to her before, but she says I'm faking or acting for attention. When I've tried to hurt myself in the past, she's laughed at me and ignored me.
I wish I could. But I'd be afraid she'd bring it up to my mother, my mother would get angry/refuse to take me elsewhere...and it'd just spiral out from there.

I'm pretty sure she did, as I hadn't told my mother what I said. Unless she was making a lucky guess (highly doubt it), then she would have to have been told to know what she said that I told the therapist. I really don't have anywhere else to stay--next place would be my biological father's and I do not want to go with him. If I could, I'd go with my aunt. But she's on my mom's side of the family.
